summary: A session-refresh module with one planted defect per diff-reading lens.
unrunnableReason: the fixture is a library with no runnable surface; the behavior lens has nothing to launch

planted.note: verify() decodes the body and never checks the MAC that sign() computed, so any attacker can mint a token for any sub. Contradicts AC4 and claim C1.
describeSession returns the raw session token to the admin console, which is exactly what AC5 says it must not do.
findUser returns undefined for an unknown sub; user.disabled then throws a TypeError rather than failing the refresh. Claim C2 is false.

Both assertions are vacuous: assert.ok(result.token) passes when nothing refreshed, and assert.ok(result) passes for any object. Neither fails if the behaviour breaks. AC1, AC2 and AC3 have no test at all.
AC1 says ten minutes; REFRESH_WINDOW_MS is five. The window is half what the plan agreed.
getUserById re-implements findUser with a linear scan over the same Map, is exported separately, and has no callers.
